title: Characterisations for coarse embeddability via quasi-locality and Schur multipliers
summary: We establish three new characterisations of coarse embeddability into Hilbert space for discrete metric spaces of bounded geometry in terms of escaping quasi-local couplings, Schur multipliers, and operator norm state localisation. As applications, we prove that if a sparse metric space of bounded geometry is coarsely embeddable into Hilbert space, then every ghost projection in the quasi-local algebra is compact, while we also provide a counterexample to the converse implication.
